discipline: Refute, do not confirm. Every digest the subject cites was recomputed over live bytes, not compared against a sibling draft. The two currency claims that carry this remasurement - that leftover-join.v3 is the current recorded G28 leftover-join at draft time and that occupancy v4 is the current G28 occupancy - were resolved by enumerating every COORD heading that mentions G28 and testing for a later successor, not by accepting the subject's own restatement. required-now 28, owners 32 of 32, the last gate row, the DR-G28 terminal token, the DR-131 status token and condition 2 at 5 of 32 were read out of live file 08. The no-cell-edit branch enumeration was parsed programmatically and tested for D-236 membership, and D-236 was opened at source to confirm it does rewrite file-08 cells and therefore must stay excluded. The subject was diffed line by line against the adopted D-252 draft so that every divergence had to justify itself as G28-specific rather than pass as template drift. Both Stage A review files were parsed as JSON so that the verdict, the counts and the observation-field claims were read off the structures themselves. The Codex counterpart review of this subject exists on disk and was deliberately not opened.
decisionRule: CONSENT only at 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Zero of each stand, so the verdict is CONSENT.

summaryStatement: Thirty-two attacks were run against live bytes and all thirty-two were refuted. The subject is unmoved at 12ef1053... mode 0444, 7701 bytes. Ten of ten cited digests plus the HEAD citation reproduce byte-exactly. HEAD is 13395db, the last live COORD heading is D-252, and required-now measures 28 of 28 with owners 32 of 32, DR-G32 terminal, the DR-G28 cell OPEN and the DR-131 status OPEN. An exhaustive sweep of G28 COORD headings returns exactly D-154, D-203 and D-228, so leftover-join.v3 is genuinely the current record at draft time and occupancy v4 is genuinely the current occupancy; the draft states both correctly and qualifies every non-currency sentence on the successor being recorded. leftoverDesign is recited as [OBL-G28-FX-AUTHORING], matching the candidate. Both Stage A reviews parse to ACCEPT 0/0, and the observation-disposition table matches their actual structures, including the absence of an observationsNotFindings field on the Claude side and an empty list on the Codex side. The no-cell-edit branch enumerates D-170 through D-235 and D-237 through D-252 and does not span D-236, whose exclusion was confirmed at source as a genuine file-08 cell rewrite. Zero MUST-FIX and zero SHOULD-FIX stand. CONSENT.
